description: feature:score — implement ScoreScreen (F-06) with a Compose Canvas ring chart (drawArc, NO third-party chart library) and ScoreViewModel (@HiltViewModel + StateFlow), and wire the 'Apply for a loan' CTA to navigate to the LOANS route. F-06 per wireframe lines ~576-626: ring chart with score + tier, Bronze->Gold tier track, 4 component progress bars (catch consistency, loan repayment, BMU compliance, community), Apply for a loan CTA. INDEPENDENT of other FEATs (LOANS route constant already exists in NangaNavHost).
steps: Read /Users/Komarov/Documents/Nanga/NANGA_WIREFRAMES.html lines 576-626 for F-06 markup. Read core/ui TealGradientHeader.kt and theme/Color.kt tokens (BorderLight for ring track, GreenMid for progress arc, GreenDeep for fills/percent text, Amber for BMU compliance low value, Slate for tier labels, InkDark for score number).

Create feature/score/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/score/ScoreUiState.kt: data class ScoreComponent(name, percent:Int, colorTokenName:String) but prefer passing resolved Color in the UI; simpler: data class ScoreComponent(name:String, percent:Int, isWarning:Boolean); data class ScoreUiState(score:Int, tier:String, tierProgressPercent:Int, components:List<ScoreComponent>, isLoading:Boolean). Components order: catch consistency 82, loan repayment 100, BMU compliance 61 (isWarning=true), community 75.

Create feature/score/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/score/ScoreViewModel.kt: @HiltViewModel class ScoreViewModel : ViewModel() exposing StateFlow<ScoreUiState> seeded in init with sample data matching wireframe (score 672, tier 'SILVER', tierProgress 68 to Gold, components as above). No repository injection (see context.json decision #1).

Replace feature/score/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/score/ScoreScreen.kt: @Composable fun ScoreScreen(onNavigateToLoans: () -> Unit, viewModel: ScoreViewModel = hiltViewModel()). Layout (Column, verticalScroll): TealGradientHeader(title="Baharini Score"); ring chart = Box { Canvas(modifier=Modifier.size(120.dp)) { drawArc(color=BorderLight, startAngle=-90f, sweepAngle=360f, useCenter=false, style=Stroke(width=10.dp.toPx(), cap=StrokeCap.Round)); val sweep = 360f * (score/100f); drawArc(color=GreenMid, startAngle=-90f, sweepAngle=sweep, useCenter=false, style=Stroke(width=10.dp.toPx(), cap=StrokeCap.Round)) } ; centered Text(score, headlineLarge/bold InkDark) + Text(tier, labelMedium Slate bold) aligned Center }. Compute percent = score (use score as the 0-1000 scale or map score to percent; match wireframe showing 672 with arc ~68% — use tierProgressPercent for the arc sweep to keep it consistent). tier track: Row(Bronze label, LinearProgressIndicator/Box progress 68% gradient GreenDeep->GreenMid, Gold label). 'Score components' section label; card with 4 rows: name + percent (GreenDeep, Amber if isWarning) + a progress bar (Box with BorderLight track + GreenMid/Amber fill). 'Apply for a loan' primary Button -> onNavigateToLoans. Use androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas + androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke + StrokeCap.Round — NO chart library import. Use NangaTheme tokens only.

In app/src/main/java/com/nanga/app/navigation/NangaNavHost.kt: change composable(Routes.SCORE){ ScoreScreen() } to composable(Routes.SCORE){ ScoreScreen(onNavigateToLoans = { navController.navigate(Routes.LOANS) }) }. Routes.LOANS already exists.

Run: cd /Users/Komarov/Documents/Nanga/.worktrees/phase4b-screens/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug — expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Confirm feature/score has NO import of any chart library (e.g. no vico/mpandroid) — only androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas. Commit on branch phase4b-screens via git -C /Users/Komarov/Documents/Nanga/.worktrees/phase4b-screens. Do not push.
